# @stapel/tasks-react 0.1.1

Headless React flow pair for stapel-tasks (contract >=0.3 <0.4) — business + state, zero visual opinion.
Built on @stapel/core: typed client + StapelApiError envelope, auth token refresh,
verification-403 interception, i18n engine, analytics facade, TanStack Query layer.

## The one right way (do this, the rest is a review/lint smell)
- No raw fetch/axios. The client is injected via <TasksProvider>/StapelConfigProvider;
  every hook and flow already carries auth, refresh, and the error envelope.
- Render errors, never try/catch them: a flow's state carries FlowError{code,params};
  render `t(code, params)` and branch on `explainTasksError(code)` remediation.
- Server state = the use* hooks (query layer); keys come only from tasksQueryKeys.
- User strings = i18n keys (registerTasksI18n); never string literals.
- Sign-in UI = a headless flow component; copy it (shadcn-style) to restyle.

## Layers
api (typed client) · model (hooks, session) · flows (machines) · headless · i18n

## Documented flows (flows.json — canonical id, steps, endpoints)
- tasks.board_setup: GET /tasks/api/v1/boards/presets, POST /tasks/api/v1/boards, POST /tasks/api/v1/boards/<uuid:board_id>/columns, POST /tasks/api/v1/boards/<uuid:board_id>/columns/reorder
- tasks.card_lifecycle: GET /tasks/api/v1/boards, GET /tasks/api/v1/boards/<uuid:board_id>/cards, POST /tasks/api/v1/boards/<uuid:board_id>/tasks, GET /tasks/api/v1/tasks/<uuid:task_id>, PATCH /tasks/api/v1/tasks/<uuid:task_id>, POST /tasks/api/v1/tasks/<uuid:task_id>/assign, POST /tasks/api/v1/tasks/<uuid:task_id>/comments, POST /tasks/api/v1/tasks/<uuid:task_id>/checklist/<uuid:item_id>/state, DELETE /tasks/api/v1/tasks/<uuid:task_id>
- tasks.card_move: POST /tasks/api/v1/tasks/<uuid:task_id>/move

## Operations (typed; use the named op, never a path string)
Request/response schema names are in manifest.json + the generated types.
Paths are relative to `/tasks/api/v1/`.
- tasks_api_v1_boards_cards_retrieve: GET /boards/{board_id}/cards
- tasks_api_v1_boards_columns_create: POST /boards/{board_id}/columns
- tasks_api_v1_boards_columns_list: GET /boards/{board_id}/columns
- tasks_api_v1_boards_columns_reorder_create: POST /boards/{board_id}/columns/reorder
- tasks_api_v1_boards_create: POST /boards
- tasks_api_v1_boards_destroy: DELETE /boards/{board_id}
- tasks_api_v1_boards_list: GET /boards
- tasks_api_v1_boards_partial_update: PATCH /boards/{board_id}
- tasks_api_v1_boards_presets_retrieve: GET /boards/presets
- tasks_api_v1_boards_retrieve: GET /boards/{board_id}
- tasks_api_v1_boards_tasks_create: POST /boards/{board_id}/tasks
- tasks_api_v1_boards_tasks_retrieve: GET /boards/{board_id}/tasks
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_assign_create: POST /tasks/{task_id}/assign
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_checklist_create: POST /tasks/{task_id}/checklist
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_checklist_list: GET /tasks/{task_id}/checklist
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_checklist_state_create: POST /tasks/{task_id}/checklist/{item_id}/state
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_comments_create: POST /tasks/{task_id}/comments
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_comments_list: GET /tasks/{task_id}/comments
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_destroy: DELETE /tasks/{task_id}
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_move_create: POST /tasks/{task_id}/move
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_partial_update: PATCH /tasks/{task_id}
- tasks_api_v1_tasks_retrieve: GET /tasks/{task_id}

## Query hooks (server state; keys come only from the key factory)
- useAddChecklistItem (mutation) → addChecklistItem
- useAddColumn (mutation) → addColumn
- useAddComment (mutation) → addComment
- useArchiveBoard (mutation) → archiveBoard
- useArchiveTask (mutation) → archiveTask
- useAssign (mutation) → assign
- useBoardCardsQuery (query) → boardCards
- useBoardQuery (query) → board
- useBoardsQuery (query) → boards
- useChecklistQuery (query) → checklist
- useCommentsQuery (query) → comments
- useCreateBoard (mutation) → createBoard
- useCreateTaskMutation (mutation) → createTask
- useMoveTask (mutation) → moveTask
- useReorderColumns (mutation) → reorderColumns
- useSetChecklistState (mutation) → setChecklistState
- useTaskQuery (query) → task
- useUpdateBoard (mutation) → updateBoard
- useUpdateTask (mutation) → updateTask
- useVocabularyQuery (query) → presets

## Errors (render t(code, params); UX from remediation)
57 keys (full catalog: manifest.json §errors). By remediation: fix_input 24 · retry 20 · verify 5 · wait_and_retry 5 · contact_support 2 · reauthenticate 1.
Param-bearing keys (interpolation slots matter):
- error.400.field.blank [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.does_not_exist [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.invalid [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.invalid_choice [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.max_length [400] → fix_input {field,max_length}
- error.400.field.max_value [400] → fix_input {field,max_value}
- error.400.field.min_length [400] → fix_input {field,min_length}
- error.400.field.min_value [400] → fix_input {field,min_value}
- error.400.field.null [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.required [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.unique [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.429.rate_limit [429] → wait_and_retry {retry_after_minutes}

## Analytics events (typed; defineEvent → events.json, drift-gated)
- (no app defineEvent() in this pair — its analytic events are the
  auto-instrumented flow funnels below)

## Flow funnels (auto-instrumented: flow.<id>.<step> {phase})
- flow.tasks.board_setup.<step> — 5 documented step(s)
- flow.tasks.card_lifecycle.<step> — 11 documented step(s)
- flow.tasks.card_move.<step> — 4 documented step(s)

```tsx
// Typed event + tracked() click (the one right way; §3.1).
const planSelected = defineEvent({
  name: "pricing.plan.selected",
  description: "User picked a plan",
  props: { plan: prop.oneOf(["free", "pro", "team"], "Plan code") },
});
const { tracked } = useTracked();
<Button onClick={tracked(planSelected, { plan }, startCheckout)} />
// A click that STEPS a flow machine is already instrumented — mark it
// data-analytics="flow" instead; tracked() on top double-counts (§3.2).
```

Each source file is the canonical usage snippet (open the default variant).

## Snippets
```tsx
// Error rendering + remediation branch (one pattern for every pair).
const r = explainTasksError(err.code); // 'wait_and_retry' | 'verify' | ...
return <Alert action={r}>{t(err.code, err.params)}</Alert>;
```
